name: hydrogenated castor oil + simmondsia chinensis (jojoba) seed oil + vitis vinifera (grape) seed oil
purpose: 1. Easily peels off without damaging the nail edge, ensuring safer care. 2. Quickly creates a defined nail shape, enhancing the refinement and aesthetic of your manicure. 3. A great daily aid for clean, neat nails and healthy, radiant nail edges.
uses: 1. Shake 2-3 times before use and let sit with the brush tip facing downward for 5-10 minutes. 2. Press the brush tip against the edge of your nail to gently infuse the essential oil. Gently push the brush tip along the edge of your nail to remove excess dead skin.
otcwarn: Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur. Discontinue use if signs of irritation or rash occur.
